# A09-S62: Event budget

Correspondence extract. Omissions are marked […].

[…]

What a wild week in the media mill. I hope it will bring 
 a lot of good attention to MindFuture.

Well, regarding the voter meetings: I have written an application and a draft 
 budget, which we will probably have to send to the municipality on Monday. I have just filled 
 some random numbers into the budget […]. Would you check the numbers based on what makes sense - possibly 
 add something?

[…]

If there is anything in the text that you think should be rewritten, just say so 
 - then I'll fix it :-)

[…]
